segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for jumping on, Dana. Sorry for the lag this morning; the pricing sheet was still pulling the old 42-seat count from the account, so I wanted to fix that before I sent numbers.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. We’re at 58 users now, but only 51 need full access on day one. The other 7 are managers who just need dashboards.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For 51 full seats and 7 view-only, the annual is $46,800. Implementation is $6,500 one-time, and that includes two admin trainings before go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance asked whether the invoice can split implementation in April and the subscription in May. Our budget resets May 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can set the subscription start for May 1 and invoice services on April 15. The term would run May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Legal also flagged auto-renewal. They want 60 days’ notice, not 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can approve 60 days. I’ll put that in the order form. On go-live, are you still targeting June 3, or did that move?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: June 10 is safer. Our operations lead is out the week before, and she owns the import file.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. I can send the revised order form by 3:30. I just need a few minutes after this to get the close plan and the order form saying the same thing for deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Martin in finance. If the invoice dates are clear, I think we can sign by Friday.
